title: Close out Phase 7: retro and project checkpoint
notes: 2026-09-28 11:27 - ticfac run epic-6in: v7z try 1 (run dispatch #8) reported a finding drafted for triage — proposed-tick "A re-run under a new run id holds forever on the claim its stopped predecessor left (dz1 regression; full suite red)" (key e8409b05fe6d5d4e71b0cb6a9e7e4493de055e74317271f78b194f6d24d38b8c, severity high, for this repository). Triage with `ticfac triage 6in`: every untriaged finding of the run settles there, addressed by a short key prefix — absorb (a tick under the epic, which the run then works), file (a backlog tick with an owner), fixed <commit>, or discard. A finding routed to another repository is not yours to settle and never holds the run: the run disposes of it itself — filed into the target's tracker when .tick/runners.toml allows it ([findings.route."owner/name"] file = true), else a backlog tick here naming the target; `ticfac finding` remains for promoting one into a tick that already exists; the tick closes and the finding rides to the close-out, which does not hand over while it is untriaged.
acceptance_criteria: Retro recorded; 6in's gate (ticks builds without ticfac; ticfac passes the bundle against a pinned ticks release) demonstrated
